search_text: published ZDI-16-223 ZDI-CAN-3177 HID VertX/Edge discoveryd Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2016-03-28 10.0 ['HID'] ['VertX/Edge'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of HID Edge. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the discoveryd service.
